_comment: Single common German words (abbruch, belege, blockiert, folge, grund, keim, marke, punkte, runden, schief, schranke, variante(n), verteilung, vorlauf) are NOT mapped: as identifiers they are locals, and a word-token map would also hit prose and collide per file (measured FL7: grund->reason collides in launcher.py; 8 of them collide). The prose pass translates them. FL7 run 2: identifiers that also occur inside a string literal (source pins, hasattr/getattr, monkeypatch names) or in non-Python files (shell env names; the ident map only rewrites Python NAME tokens) are NOT mapped -- mapping them broke 21 tests (test_bar1_host_cleanup, gpu_battery checks, source pins on _platzhalter/_karte).
